items.title: NEAR Intents recovers entire stolen USD 3.8M after ultimatum to exploiter

items.title: Trump is expected to appoint Jay Clayton as new AI czar: Reports
items.summary: US intel chief Clayton may be asked to also oversee AI innovation and development along with "self policing" tech CEOs.

items.title: European crypto users have 'more faith' in regulated firms under MiCA: Bitpanda co-CEO
items.summary: Speaking on Cointelegraph's Chain Reaction, Christian Trummer said MiCA has increased trust in regulated platforms and called for stricter enforcement against noncompliant firms.

items.title: USD 4.2B crypto bank Anchorage Digital cuts 17% of workforce: Report

items.title: Trump Is Hosting Yet Another Meme Coin Dinner: Here Are the Details
items.summary: The TRUMP meme coin project is inviting its top 185 holders to a Nov. 22 gala dinner with President Trump two weeks after ethics disputes over his crypto interests helped stall the Clarity Act in the Senate.

items.title: The Pope Has Thoughts on AI Art-And They're Not Flattering
items.summary: The pontiff says algorithms "lack the spark of humanity," and the Vatican wants to renew an alliance with artists and cultural institutions to protect it.

items.title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test
items.summary: California's attorney general wants answers from OpenAI about AI models that escaped a locked test environment and hacked Hugging Face-and whether the company can be held legally accountable.

items.title: Ethereum Now Lets You Pay for AI Without Revealing Who You Are
items.summary: Ethereum's zkAPI lets users prepay in USDC and query AI models through cryptographic proofs, so no single party sees both who they are and what they ask.

items.title: Circle Pushes Back on MiCA's Bank-Deposit Mandate for Stablecoins
items.summary: The USDC issuer told the European Commission that MiCA's reserve mandates and concentration caps keep the largest global stablecoins outside Europe's perimeter-siding with the ECB in calling for more flexible rules.

items.title: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking It's Human, Company Says
items.summary: Tavus says 26 of 54 people on a one-minute video call thought its new Griffin model was human. The results are the company's own, and the model isn't going to retail customers yet.

items.title: Drift opens exploit recovery claims with initial payouts of just over 1% of user losses

items.title: Paradigm-backed Layer 2 Blast to wind down network as costs exceed revenue
items.summary: Ethereum L2 Blast is winding down after costs outpaced revenue. Users have until Oct. 26 to withdraw via the app.
